transcript.text: Yo, what's up, guys? In today's video,
I'm going to be discussing the final
balance changes coming to the new season
in Clash Royale. I have already made a
video on the work-in-progress balance
changes, if you guys saw that, but these
are the final balance changes where so
where Supercell kind of took our
opinions into consideration and tweaked
the balance changes, and I'm just going
to be talking about the official ones,
what I agree with, what I disagree with,
and just like simply like what is
literally being added as well. And if
you guys do enjoy the video, please make
sure to like and subscribe, and I will
be responding to the comments discussing
the balances. Just make sure to ask any
questions that you do have, you know, in
the comments if if you have any.
Starting off, guys, which I do think was
the most controversial change about the
balance changes for the next season, it
is the nerf to the spirits. Obviously,
Clash Royale is nerfing every single
spirit, and they gave us two options at
the beginning of the work-in-progress
balance changes. The first one, and the
one that they had us test on the
developer build, was the nerf to the
running speed, which I really did not
like that one. It just felt like wrong.
It just didn't make sense in my mind for
the spirits to run as slow as they did.
So, spirits are getting a health nerf,
which will make them now get one-shot by
cards like archers, archer queen,
bomber, musketeer, Tesla, and just
things like that, making them just a
little bit worse defensively, but not
make them completely useless against
cards like bowler and executioner, still
making them always jump on those types
of cards, which I am, I guess, a fan of.
And guys, another big thing about the
balance changes this season is the nerf
to the or not the nerf, sorry, the
balances to the champions. You know,
some nerfs, some buffs, but we are
getting a massive buff to the Goblin
Giant, which this one really surprised
me because the Goblin Giant was actually
one of the most popular cards in CRL
this month, and they're giving it a 47%
buff to the damage on the doctor. You
see the doctor right here? It doesn't
really do too much damage, but it will
be doing 47% more damage next season,
but to compensate for the massive buff
to the doctor, they are nerfing the
ability. The damage per second will be
going down by 12%, which I think it's
definitely fair to give a compensation
nerf to a card where they gave such a
big buff to. Definitely am happy that
they realized that maybe, you know, the
buff would be a bit too much. And they
are also to my, you know, I'm very happy
about this. So, they are actually
buffing the little prince. The little
prince is getting a very strange balance
that I've never actually seen in the
game before. It's getting a hit
conservation damage buff. And
essentially what it is, guys, don't
quote me on this, but
essentially, right? Do you know how like
the little prince gets reset every
single time it moves? Now it has a 0.3
second window where it can move but not
be reset. It has to be moving for more
than 0.3 seconds for it to be reset to
lose that maximum charge. Cuz the little
prince just when it would move, it would
just become so bad. And more often than
not, you wouldn't be able to charge it
up more than one time every time you had
it down. And it just would make it so it
just did not get enough value simply.
And it should be a lot better. And they
are also buffing the guardian damage by
7% as well, which I guess is cool. The
guardian does not really do too much
damage, but I don't know if it was
really necessary if I'm being completely
honest. And guys, they are actually
doing a buff to the mighty miner as
well. They're buffing the mighty miner
by 6% Honestly, I don't think it was
necessary. I think that the mighty miner
is one of the best cards in the game.
And I also thought that it was the best
champion in the game, you know, not a
counting heroes just like the regular
champions. And it's getting a buff by
6%, which is not very much because
mighty miner doesn't do a lot of damage.
It's going from 40 to 43 damage at
tournament level, which is pretty cool
though, cuz it is my favorite card, but
I just didn't think that it needed a
buff.
And guys, they are actually nerfing the
ronin, but it's a bug fix, which I
thought that was interesting. Like their
way of like bug fixing the ronin
actually does come as a nerf. The ronin
will now shoot uh
0.1 second slower, which will just kind
of fix the bug with the golden knight
where if you had a golden knight dashing
onto a ronin, it would actually get
reflected and the Gold Knight would not
dash onto anything. I thought that was
intentional, but apparently it was a bug
and it was also messing up against the
Dark Prince as well where it would just
one-shot the Dark Prince instead of just
taking off the shield like it normally
should. They are also doing a I would
say a buff to the X-Bow, guys. Maybe
it's a nerf, but they are making the hit
speed go a little bit slower, but in
return of making the hit speed a little
bit slower, they are buffing the damage
and they are actually buffing the
projectile speed as well. I think that
is to fix the X-Bow where like it will
shoot at a skeleton three times and it
only needs two times to kill the
skeleton, but it would end up like
shooting a third time, which I guess
that was like the bug fix that they were
doing, which is actually I guess a nice
quality of life change for the X-Bow
players, but it could make X-Bow just a
little bit too strong in my opinion if
they're not careful. Who knows though?
And moving on, guys, they're actually
doing a rework to the hero Ice Golem.
Instead of having a freeze effect, you
know, like the freeze spell,
they are now just having it do three
different slow downs and in my opinion,
that is very good because I do think
that the hero Ice Golem was very, very
good and way too good against, you know,
units that it was bad against, right? If
you had a deck where you couldn't really
defend their Hog Rider, they popped the
ability, they they get like five hits,
there's nothing they are able to do, but
because they are taking away the freeze
effect, they are actually making it do
way more damage, significant more
damage. It will actually be able to take
out Goblins, Minions and stuff like
that. And guys, they are buffing the Evo
Witch. It will maybe not necessarily a
buff, but definitely a rework. Instead
